steps.title: Reject the value of h that does not fit the diagram

lines.text: Substitute $(a, 3)$ into the circle equation to see what $a$ must be.
If $h = 12$, then $a = 14$ or $a = 10$, but $0 < a < 5$, so $h = 12$ is rejected.
